svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Placemento data model
svg.desc: Placemento data model. 4 components. Connections: Company to User (places); Company to User (selects); User to Experience (writes); User to Otp (requests).

text.tspan: The four Mongoose models in server/src/models. Links are by value, not refs; a placement update changes both Company to User links in one transaction.
